notes:
v1.3.9 Release

- Fixed: background status/news polling could silently slow down to once every few hours after a single failed check, instead of the intended 5-10 minutes
- Fixed: reopening the app could reset the background poll timer before it ever fired
- Fixed: favorites-only status could overcount an outage affecting several checks of the same pinned service (e.g. mail) as multiple outages instead of one
